details: The U.S. Consumer Price Index (CPI) for March 2026 registered a 3.3% increase year-over-year, with a month-over-month rise of 0.87%. Headline CPI for April 2026 is reported at 2.9% year-over-year, and core inflation has edged up to 2.7%. These figures consistently exceed the Federal Reserve's 2.0% target, indicating persistent inflationary pressures that could lead the Fed to maintain a hawkish monetary policy stance.
sourceName: U.S. Congress Joint Economic Committee / US Debt Clock
title: US Inflation Holds Above Fed Target in March/April 2026

details: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has revised its global growth projection for 2026 downward to 3.1%, from an earlier forecast of 3.4% in January. The revision is primarily attributed to the ongoing military conflict in the Middle East. The IMF's April 2026 World Economic Outlook also anticipates global headline inflation to increase to 4.4% in 2026, driven by higher commodity prices and a risk-off sentiment pervading financial markets.
title: IMF Cuts Global Growth Forecasts, Cites Mideast Conflict

details: The European Central Bank (ECB) is widely anticipated to keep its key interest rates unchanged at its upcoming decision on April 30, 2026, with market probabilities indicating a 92-97% chance of the deposit facility rate remaining at 2.00%. However, some analysts suggest that markets are now pricing in two potential rate hikes by the end of 2026, influenced by persistent increases in energy prices and rising inflation concerns across the Eurozone.
title: ECB Set to Maintain Key Interest Rates; Future Hikes Priced In

details: U.S. publicly traded Bitcoin mining companies sold over 32,000 BTC in Q1 2026, marking a new record, largely influenced by lower cryptocurrency prices and rising energy costs. Despite this selling pressure, institutional demand for Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) continues to drive significant market activity. Concurrently, the decentralized finance (DeFi) sector faces ongoing security challenges, with the Kelp DAO bridge experiencing a $292 million exploit and the Volo protocol losing $3.5 million, contributing to a total of $17 billion lost to DeFi hacks over the past decade.
title: Bitcoin Miners Liquidate BTC; Institutional Adoption Expands Amid Hacks

details: Both cryptocurrency and precious metals markets are experiencing moderate downside pressure, driven by a strengthening U.S. dollar, elevated Treasury yields, and ongoing geopolitical uncertainties. Bitcoin and Ethereum are trading softer as investors adopt a cautious stance in anticipation of the Federal Reserve's upcoming FOMC meeting (April 28-29), where the central bank is expected to maintain current interest rates, reinforcing a "higher for longer" policy outlook.
title: Crypto and Metals Drift Lower on Strong Dollar, Fed Expectations
